gallery.title: Retweet Community Honeycomb
gallery.description: A dense, ragged hexagonal social field, divided by eight organically winding communities and crossed by hierarchical retweet arcs.

file.name: retweet_users.csv + retweet_links.csv
file.description: 1,881 users form a densely packed hexagonal island with an uneven perimeter and eight irregular communities, linked by leader-to-retweeter-to-receiver propagation edges.

bindings.role: One user at each packed hex position
Hex fill, forming eight contiguous regions with irregular boundaries
Hex border style for Opinion leader, Retweeter, or Receiver

gallery.composition: Layer curved Graph Link arcs over a tightly packed Hexbin on shared X and Y scales. The users form one roughly hexagonal island with a broken outer rim; warped community regions avoid straight grid-like boundaries. Eight communities control fill, user_type controls the role border, and edges mainly flow from opinion leaders to retweeters and then receivers.

editorHelp.introduction: The starter places the packed Hexbin and bound retweet Graph Link separately.

steps.title: Overlay retweet paths
steps.action: Create a Cartesian Layer sharing X and Y.
steps.result: Links connect the exact user hexes without changing the honeycomb community layout.
